connections.why: How young people present themselves overlaps with health and leisure choices
Food, festivals and free time are all part of how people live
Technology and social-media skills feed into modern working life
Describing your locality extends to the wider region and country
Travel and tourism raise questions about the environment
Directions and local information are staple listening contexts
School studies lead into decisions about future study and careers
Work experience shapes the career plans students describe
School life is a frequent prompt for the extended writing task
Environmental and social issues are common essay and translation topics
Listening and reading are the two receptive skills tested on every theme
Speaking and writing are the productive skills that reuse topic vocabulary
Personal-identity vocabulary drives the speaking conversation
Texts about festivals and food are common reading sources
Future plans are a standard topic in the speaking conversation
